summary: feat(settings): add PairUnsupportedHint with view and os variants
description:
Because:

* Pairing on a mobile browser outside Firefox needs a hint that
  tells the user how to finish in the Firefox app.

This commit:

* Adds PairUnsupportedHint with view (webview, tab) and os
  (android, ios) variants, strings, stories and menu images.
* Shows the same "Tap the app menu" step on iOS and Android.

Closes FXA-14844
